# Affordable Fence

> Affordable Fence installs wood, vinyl, aluminum, and chain link fences for residential and commercial properties. Free estimates, fast installs, and a 10-year workmanship warranty.

## Services

- Wood Privacy Fence — cedar and pressure-treated panels from $28/ft
- Vinyl Fence — zero maintenance, zero rot from $34/ft
- Aluminum & Ornamental — powder-coated for pools and gardens from $42/ft
- Chain Link — most affordable property security from $16/ft
- Residential Fence installation
- Commercial Fence installation
- DIY Fencing materials and guidance
- Railings — porch, step, and code-compliant
